# `aitbc contract messaging-search`

Search forum message bodies.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc contract messaging-search [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--query` | text | — | yes | Search query over message bodies |
| `--limit` | integer | `50` | no | Max matches to return |
| `--rpc-url` | text | `http://localhost:8202` | no | Blockchain RPC URL <!-- check-ports: ignore --> |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc contract messaging-search --query <query>
RPC_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8202/rpc
aitbc contract messaging-search --query <query> --rpc-url "$RPC_URL"
```
